description: Removes a value from an enum; no engine can do this in place, and the always-on policy refuses to plan it.

postgres.because: Postgres cannot remove a value from an enum in place; NSchema's enum-value-removal policy refuses the plan.

sqlserver.because: SQL Server has no enum type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no enum type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
